units: <cite ref="Yoma 28b:16">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>קָשׁוּ משמשא</he> are harder (on the eye) &c., v. <cite ref="U00184"><he>שַׁבְרִירֵי</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to find a thing difficult to understand, to object, argue against, dispute.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 5:1:13">Y. Ter. V, 43ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ סימון קַשְׁיְיתָהּ … קיימה</he> R. Simon argued against it (refuted it), but R. Ba. … proved it to be correct. Y. Kidd. III, 64ᶜ top [read:] <he>לא כבר קְשׁוּנְתָּהּ הרי עולם לא כבר קַשְׁיְתָהּ וכ׳</he> have not mountains of the world (great scholars) disputed it? did not R. El. dispute it in the presence of &c.; Y. Ned. VIII, 40ᵈ sq. (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 66b:14">B. Kam. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מילתא ק׳ בה רבה לרב וכ׳</he> Rabbah argued this difficulty before R. Joseph for twenty-two years, and it was not solved; <cite ref="Ketubot 42b:9">Keth. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>האי</he> … <he>קְשָׁאֵי רבה ורב וכ׳</he> Rabbah and R. Joseph discussed this difficulty &c.—Part. <cite ref="S02238"><he>קָשֵׁי</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="S02238"><he>קַשְׁיָא</he></cite>, q. v.
<cite ref="Pesachim 78b:15">Pes. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>מתניתן קַשִּׁיתֵיה וכ׳</he> the Mishnah perplexed him; why does it read &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 2:10">Targ. II Kings II, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 12:4">Targ. I Kings XII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 95:8">Targ. Ps. XCV, 8</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16:2">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>כד הוה צערא קשי עלוי … וכד הוה מַקְשֵׁי וכ׳</he> when his suffering was severe, he said, God the faithful, but when it was severer on him than necessary &c.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:6">Targ. Job VI, 6</cite> Ms. Var. <he>מדלית מַקְשׁה עליה</he> when there is none to dispute it.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 77a:1">Yeb. 77ᵃ</cite> top <he>א׳ להו דואג כל הני קושייתא</he> Doeg brought up before them all those arguments. Y. Yoma I, 38ᵈ bot. <he>עד דאת מַקְשֵׁי … קְשַׁיְיתָהּ על וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="S02248"><he>קשייתא</he></cite>) instead of offering objection against R. J., rather offer it against &c.; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 35:16">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXV, 16</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Yevamot 40a:26">Yeb. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>ומִיקְּשֵׁה היא דאיקשי לך וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>דקשיא</he>) it was perplexing to thee, and thou didst reverse it.
